_comment: Editor layout for the TCSPC SawNuModel (FRET: FD (SAW-nu)). The Convolution/Generic/Corrections/Anisotropy panels describe the same nuisance groups as lifetime.view.json -- keep them in step, a control added to only one is a parity gap between editors a user reads as the same. Model-specific: the RMS end-to-end distance and the self-avoiding-walk scaling exponent nu.

sections.title: Convolution

sections.label: Type
sections.description: Excitation scheme for the IRF convolution.
descriptions: Periodic excitation: the decay wraps around the repetition period (pulsed laser, tails overlap).
Single excitation, truncated at the histogram window; no wrap-around.
Full (numpy) convolution of one excitation with the model, without wrap-around.

sections.label: Convolve
sections.description: Convolve the model with the IRF. Switch off to compare the bare decay.
Convolution of the model decay with the instrument response function (IRF): IRF curve, excitation mode, convolve switch and IRF time shift.

sections.title: Generic
sections.description: Nuisance terms of the decay: scattered light, constant background (and its curve) and photon counts.

sections.title: Corrections

sections.label: Smoothing
sections.description: Window used to smooth the linearization (DNL) table before it is applied; flat = no smoothing.

items.label: Pile-up
items.description: Correct pile-up distortion of the TCSPC histogram (early photons over-represented at high count rates).

items.label: DNL
items.description: Apply the differential non-linearity (DNL) table to the model to account for uneven channel widths.

items.label: Reverse
items.description: Reverse the time axis of the data (for reverse start-stop acquisition).

sections.description: Switches for the amplitude normalisation of the species.
Detector corrections: DNL linearization table, pile-up and channel smoothing applied to the decay.

sections.title: Donor
sections.description: Fluorescence decay of the donor in the absence of FRET.

sections.title: SAW chain
sections.description: Self-avoiding-walk polymer model of the linker: distance distribution set by the chain length and the scaling exponent nu.

sections.title: FRET parameters

sections.description: Orientation factor: dynamic averaging uses the scalar kappa-squared, static averaging uses its distribution. 'show' plots the current distribution, 'compute' derives one from anisotropies, 'calc R0' opens the Foerster-radius calculator.
Foerster radius R0, orientation factor kappa-squared, refractive index and donor lifetime/FRET-rate settings that turn distances into FRET rates.

sections.title: Anisotropy

sections.label: Polarization
sections.description: Measured polarization: vm = magic angle, vv / vh = parallel / perpendicular detection, vv/vh = both fitted together.
Background-corrected VV/VH integrals, and r(t) for data and model with the correction factors as live controls.
Rotational depolarization: polarization channel, rotational correlation times and the G factor and related polarization corrections.
